title.narrative: Technical Assistance Project for Upgrading of the Ethiopian Leather and Leather Products Industry

description.narrative: The origin of the proposal is based on the Official request of assistance sent by the Ethiopian Ministry of Industry (MoI) for exten ding the on-going project for #The upgrading of the Ethiopian Leather and Leather Products Industry#- TE/ETH/08/008. The main objective of the present project extension is to fully implement the action plans for improving the development and the organization of local small production units, working in the leather products sector. Following the UNIDO Cluster development methodology, the natural time for achieving a mature cluster is taking a range of time between 5 up to 7 years. For this reason, in order to achieve this objective the project expects to implement the action plans developed by the current leather project for developing 3 clusters (already identified by the on-going project) in Addis Ababa and for continuing to provide backstopping support activities to the Ethiopian Regions. The project objective is to increase the quality of leather products produced by MSEs (micro and small enterprises) in accordance with domestic and international standards, through the implementation of the action plans developed by the on-going project. This will result in continuing to provide the selected clusters and the regions with the necessary assistance in implementing the action plans
